tours.title: Sri Lanka History & Southern Charm
tours.tagline: Discover ancient wonders, misty mountains, wild safaris and beautiful beaches in one unforgettable journey.
tours.overview:
Discover Sri Lanka on a 10-day journey through ancient cities, misty mountain landscapes, wildlife-rich national parks and sunlit southern beaches. Begin in Anuradhapura and Polonnaruwa, where centuries-old stupas, royal ruins and sacred sites reveal the island’s fascinating past. Visit the iconic Sigiriya Rock Fortress before continuing to Kandy, the tea-covered hills of Nuwara Eliya and the scenic village of Ella, known for its mountain views and famous Nine Arch Bridge.

The adventure continues through Udawalawe and Yala, where guided safaris offer the chance to see elephants and other wildlife in their natural habitats. Along the southern coast, enjoy Mirissa’s beautiful beaches, explore the historic streets of Galle Fort and make time for exciting water sports in Bentota. The journey finishes in Colombo, where temples, city landmarks and lively streets offer a final glimpse of modern Sri Lankan life.

With private transport, comfortable hotel stays and a mix of culture, nature and adventure, this tour brings together many of Sri Lanka’s most memorable experiences in one journey.

tours.title: Ceylon Romance: Highlands, Heritage & Oceanfront Luxury
tours.tagline: Celebrate your love with misty mountain views, unforgettable sunsets and romantic stays along Sri Lanka’s beautiful southern coast.
tours.overview: Celebrate your honeymoon with an unforgettable journey through Sri Lanka’s most romantic landscapes. Begin among the ancient wonders of Sigiriya and the peaceful lake views of Dambulla, where nature and heritage create a beautiful setting for your first days together. Continue to Ella, a charming hill-country escape surrounded by lush tea plantations, misty mountains and scenic trails. Discover the famous Nine Arch Bridge, enjoy the fresh mountain air and spend quiet moments overlooking the green valleys. Your journey then leads to the southern coast, where golden beaches, ocean views and luxury stays invite you to slow down and enjoy time together. Explore the historic streets and coastal ramparts of Galle Fort, enjoy romantic dining and leave space for relaxing by the pool or watching the sunset. Combining cultural discoveries, beautiful scenery and carefully selected luxury accommodation, this eight-day journey offers couples a memorable way to celebrate their love in Sri Lanka.

Discover the very best of Sri Lanka on an exclusive private journey designed for discerning travellers. From the ancient wonders of the Cultural Triangle to the misty tea-covered mountains, venture into the wild landscapes of Yala and unwind along the golden southern coast, all with the comfort and flexibility of your own private chauffeur.

Stay in carefully selected 5-star hotels and luxury resorts, combining exceptional hospitality, beautiful surroundings and refined comfort. Explore UNESCO World Heritage Sites, ancient temples and fortresses, experience the charm of Sri Lanka’s hill country, enjoy a scenic train journey through the mountains and embark on an unforgettable wildlife safari in Yala National Park.

Continue to the southern coast for beautiful beaches, coastal experiences and the historic Galle Fort, before concluding your journey in vibrant Colombo. With a relaxed pace, private chauffeur service and thoughtfully selected experiences, this is Sri Lanka at its most captivating — a seamless blend of luxury, culture, nature, wildlife and unforgettable moments.

tours.title: Ceylon Heritage Adventure
tours.tagline: Scenic Sri Lanka Escape – Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Kitulgala White Water Rafting & Colombo
tours.overview:
Experience the beauty and adventure of Sri Lanka on a 4-day, 3-night private chauffeur tour covering Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Kitulgala and Colombo. This exciting journey combines cultural heritage, misty mountains, tea plantations, waterfalls, adventure and vibrant city experiences.

Explore Kandy, Sri Lanka's cultural capital, including the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and the city's highlights. Continue into the scenic hill country towards Nuwara Eliya, visiting beautiful viewpoints, tea plantations, a tea factory and waterfalls while enjoying the cool climate and spectacular mountain scenery.

Continue to Kitulgala, one of Sri Lanka's most popular adventure destinations, and experience exciting white water rafting through the scenic Kelani River surrounded by lush rainforest. The journey then continues to Colombo for a city tour covering key attractions before your departure. Travel comfortably throughout the tour with a private vehicle and English-speaking chauffeur.

tours.title: Hikkaduwa: Coral Reef & Beach Break
tours.tagline: Coastal charm, colourful reefs and the beauty of Sri Lanka’s southern shores.
tours.overview:
Discover the charm of Sri Lanka’s southern coastline on a three-day escape combining beautiful beaches, colourful marine life and historic coastal heritage. Begin in Hikkaduwa, a popular seaside destination known for its coral sanctuary, tropical waters and opportunities for snorkelling, glass-bottom boat rides and relaxing by the beach. Continue to Galle, where the historic Dutch Fort invites you to explore its old streets, colonial architecture, charming boutiques and ocean-facing ramparts. The journey also includes Bentota, known for its golden beaches, swaying palms and relaxed coastal atmosphere.

With a balance of seaside relaxation, cultural discovery and scenic coastal drives, this short getaway offers a refreshing break from everyday life. Whether you prefer exploring historic landmarks, enjoying the ocean views or spending time by the shore, this journey brings together three distinctive destinations along Sri Lanka’s beautiful southern and western coastline.

tours.title: Bentota Beach & Watersports
tours.tagline: Escape to Sri Lanka’s Golden Coast for sun-soaked beaches, thrilling water sports, peaceful river safaris and a relaxing beachfront resort getaway.
tours.overview: Discover the best of Sri Lanka’s southern coastline with a refreshing three-day escape to Bentota, where golden beaches, tropical waterways and exciting adventures come together. Begin your journey with a scenic chauffeur-driven transfer from Colombo and settle into a beachfront resort, where you can unwind by the ocean and enjoy a beautiful sunset over the coast. The adventure continues with a relaxing boat safari along the Madu Ganga, winding through lush mangrove channels and peaceful waterways. Visit a local turtle hatchery to learn about sea turtle conservation before heading to Bentota’s waters for an afternoon of exciting water sports. Whether you prefer the thrill of gliding across the lagoon or simply relaxing beside the sea, this getaway offers a wonderful balance of adventure and leisure. Enjoy comfortable four-star resort accommodation, delicious meals and convenient private transfers before a peaceful final morning by the ocean and your return to Colombo or the airport.

tours.title: Horton Plains, World's End
tours.tagline: Trek the cloud forest plateau of Horton Plains to stand at the dizzying 870m vertical precipice of World's End.
tours.overview:
Discover the breathtaking beauty of Sri Lanka’s central highlands on an unforgettable three-day trekking adventure through Nuwara Eliya, Horton Plains, and Ohiya. This journey combines spectacular mountain scenery, mist-covered forests, rolling tea plantations, and charming highland villages, offering an authentic experience of Sri Lanka’s natural wonders.

Begin your adventure in Nuwara Eliya, surrounded by lush tea estates and refreshing mountain air, before exploring the remarkable landscapes of Horton Plains National Park. Walk through unique montane forests and open grasslands, admire dramatic viewpoints, and experience the famous World’s End escarpment. Continue towards Ohiya, a peaceful mountain village known for its scenic trails, remote atmosphere, and stunning panoramic views.

Along the way, discover diverse wildlife, crystal-clear streams, and the tranquil beauty of the highlands. With rewarding hikes, picturesque landscapes, and memorable encounters with nature, this three-day adventure is perfect for nature lovers, hiking enthusiasts, and travelers seeking an authentic Sri Lankan mountain experience.

tours.title: Pigeon Island Marine Park & Coastal Wildlife
tours.tagline: Discover the vibrant reefs, turquoise waters and peaceful beaches of Sri Lanka’s east coast.
tours.overview: Discover the natural beauty of Sri Lanka’s eastern coastline on this five-day escape through Trincomalee, Nilaveli and Pigeon Island. Spend your days enjoying clear blue waters, soft sandy beaches and the relaxed atmosphere of the coast. The highlight of the journey is a boat excursion to Pigeon Island Marine National Park, where you can explore colourful coral reefs and look out for tropical fish, sea turtles and reef sharks while snorkelling in suitable sea conditions. Enjoy time to unwind on Nilaveli Beach, known for its beautiful shoreline and peaceful surroundings, before discovering Trincomalee’s coastal landmarks and cultural heritage. Visit the sacred Koneswaram Temple, perched above the Indian Ocean, and take in the sweeping views from Swami Rock. With a balance of marine exploration, beachside relaxation and local culture, this package offers a refreshing coastal getaway for travellers looking to experience another side of Sri Lanka.

tours.title: Sinharaja: Into the Emerald Rainforest
tours.tagline: Step into a world of ancient trees, hidden wildlife and winding forest trails in Sri Lanka’s remarkable UNESCO-listed rainforest.
tours.overview: Discover a different side of Sri Lanka on this four-day, three-night journey through Sinharaja, Deniyaya and Galle. Begin with the incredible beauty of Sinharaja Forest Reserve, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its dense rainforest, rare wildlife and remarkable variety of plant life. Walk along shaded forest trails with a local guide, listen to birds calling through the trees and look out for colourful butterflies, reptiles and wildlife that make this forest so special. Continue to Deniyaya, a peaceful countryside town surrounded by green hills, tea plantations and rural landscapes, where you can slow down and enjoy the natural beauty of the area. The journey then takes you to Galle, where historic streets, old buildings and ocean views offer a change of scenery. Explore the famous Galle Fort and enjoy the relaxed atmosphere of Sri Lanka’s southern coast. Combining rainforest adventures, countryside scenery and coastal heritage, this package offers a memorable way to experience three distinct sides of the island.

tours.title: Mirissa: Blue Whales & Ocean Giants
tours.tagline: Sail into the deep waters of the Indian Ocean to encounter the largest animal ever known: the magnificent Blue Whale.
tours.overview: Discover the magic of Sri Lanka’s southern coast on a four-day luxury escape filled with ocean adventures, golden beaches and centuries of history. Beginning at Bandaranaike International Airport, enjoy a comfortable private transfer to the beautiful shores of Mirissa, where turquoise waters and tropical landscapes set the scene for your coastal retreat. The highlight awaits offshore, as you venture into the deep waters of the Indian Ocean in search of magnificent blue whales and other marine giants. Back on land, explore the hidden beauty of Secret Beach, take in sweeping ocean views from Coconut Tree Hill and enjoy the relaxed charm of the southern coastline. Your journey continues with an opportunity to snorkel alongside sea turtles before discovering the cobbled streets, historic ramparts and colonial heritage of UNESCO-listed Galle Fort. With carefully selected luxury accommodation, delightful breakfasts and dinners, and comfortable private transfers, this getaway brings together unforgettable wildlife encounters, coastal relaxation and cultural discovery.

tours.title: Minneriya:  Elephant Gathering
tours.tagline: Three days of wild encounters, ancient wonders and 5 star luxury in the heart of Sri Lanka.
tours.overview:
Discover the wild beauty and timeless wonders of Sri Lanka on a three-day luxury escape through Minneriya, Habarana and Sigiriya. At the heart of this journey is the spectacular Great Elephant Gathering, where herds of wild elephants come together near the Minneriya Reservoir, creating one of the island’s most unforgettable wildlife experiences. Venture into the national park on an exciting safari, watching these magnificent animals in their natural habitat against a backdrop of open grasslands and shimmering waters.

Beyond the wilderness, explore the legendary landscape of Sigiriya, home to the iconic Lion Rock, where ancient history meets breathtaking scenery. Habarana offers the perfect gateway to the Cultural Triangle, surrounded by lush greenery, peaceful countryside and exceptional wildlife. After days filled with discovery, retreat to handpicked five-star accommodation, enjoy refined dining and unwind in comfort. From thrilling safari moments to the grandeur of Sri Lanka’s ancient heritage, this journey brings together nature, culture and indulgence in one remarkable getaway.

tours.title: Wilpattu Untamed: Lakes, Leopards & Sloth Bears
tours.tagline: Follow wild trails, discover ancient kingdoms and unwind by the coast.
tours.overview: Discover a quieter, wilder side of Sri Lanka on this four-day journey through Wilpattu, Anuradhapura and Negombo. The experience begins in Wilpattu National Park, famous for its natural lakes, known as willus, and its mix of forest, scrubland and open clearings. Explore the park on a guided jeep safari, keeping an eye out for Sri Lankan leopards, sloth bears, elephants and birdlife in their natural surroundings. Wildlife sightings are never guaranteed, which makes every safari a little different. Continue to Anuradhapura, one of Sri Lanka’s most important ancient cities, where sacred Buddhist sites, historic stupas and centuries-old ruins offer a glimpse into the island’s rich past. Finish in Negombo, a lively coastal town known for its sandy beaches, fishing traditions and relaxed seaside atmosphere. Combining wildlife, history and time by the ocean, this package offers a varied introduction to Sri Lanka’s natural landscapes and cultural heritage.

tours.title: Heritage of the North: Jaffna Cultural Odyssey
tours.tagline: Discover the soul of Northern Sri Lanka, from Jaffna’s rich Tamil heritage and remote island wonders to the sacred ancient city of Anuradhapura.
tours.overview: Explore a different side of Sri Lanka on this six-day cultural journey through the Northern Peninsula and the island’s ancient heartland. Begin in Jaffna, where colourful Hindu temples, historic Dutch architecture and distinctive Tamil traditions reveal the region’s unique character. Travel beyond the mainland by ferry to Delft Island, known for its wild horses, baobab trees and old coral walls, before visiting the sacred island shrine of Nagadeepa. Continue to Keerimalai’s natural springs and Point Pedro, Sri Lanka’s northernmost point, taking in the quieter coastal landscapes along the way. The journey then heads south to Anuradhapura, one of the country’s most important ancient capitals. Experience its deep spiritual atmosphere with visits to Mihintale and the revered Ruwanwelisaya Stupa before your final transfer to Colombo Airport. With comfortable four-star accommodation, selected meals and a mix of cultural discovery, island exploration and sacred landmarks, this tour offers a memorable introduction to Northern Sri Lanka.

tours.title: Wildlife Safari & Cultural Marvels
tours.tagline: Ancient kingdoms, wild safaris and beautiful southern shores discover the history, wildlife and coastal charm of Sri Lanka in one unforgettable 10-day journey.
tours.overview:
Discover the many sides of Sri Lanka on a 10-day journey through ancient kingdoms, sacred cultural landmarks, wildlife-rich national parks and beautiful southern beaches. Begin in Sigiriya, home to the remarkable Lion Rock fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its ancient gardens, frescoes and impressive rock-top ruins. Continue to Polonnaruwa, another UNESCO-listed destination, where the remains of a medieval royal capital reveal centuries of history through stone temples, statues and ancient irrigation works.

In Kandy, explore the island’s living traditions and visit the revered Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, within the UNESCO-listed Sacred City. Then trade historic streets for the untamed landscapes of Yala National Park, where guided safaris offer the chance to spot elephants, crocodiles, colourful birdlife and, with luck, the elusive Sri Lankan leopard.

The journey continues to Mirissa, where palm-lined beaches and the Indian Ocean invite you to slow down and enjoy the coast. Finish in Galle, exploring its UNESCO-listed Dutch-era fortifications, historic lanes and ocean-facing ramparts. Combining cultural discovery, wildlife experiences and time by the sea, this tour offers a rewarding introduction to Sri Lanka’s heritage and natural beauty.

tours.title: Sri Lanka Ramayana Sacred Trails
tours.tagline: Walk the sacred path of the Ramayana through Sri Lanka’s legendary temples, ancient sites and landscapes steeped in devotion.
tours.overview: Follow the sacred stories of the Ramayana across Sri Lanka on a seven-day journey through ancient temples, legendary landscapes and places of deep religious significance. Begin along the eastern coast at Trincomalee’s Koneswaram Temple, dramatically positioned above the Indian Ocean, before exploring Sigiriya and its remarkable rock fortress, often associated with local traditions surrounding King Ravana. Continue to Munneswaram and Manavari, where Hindu tradition connects Lord Rama’s journey with prayers to Lord Shiva. In the central highlands, visit Seetha Amman Temple and the believed location of Ashoka Vatika, alongside Gayathri Peedam. The journey continues through the scenic hills to Divurumpola, associated in local tradition with Sita’s fire ordeal, and Ravana Falls, linked to the island’s enduring Ramayana legends. Combining sacred pilgrimage sites, cultural heritage and beautiful natural scenery, this tour offers a meaningful way to explore Sri Lanka through the stories and beliefs that have been passed down through generations.

tours.title: Ecological Wonders of Sri Lanka
tours.tagline: Discover Sri Lanka’s wildlife, lush landscapes and beautiful coastal scenery.
tours.overview: Experience the natural beauty and cultural charm of Sri Lanka on this five-day journey through Kandy, Pinnawala, Bentota and Colombo. Begin with a visit to Pinnawala, known for its elephant experiences and surrounding greenery, before exploring the scenic hill capital of Kandy, home to sacred temples, botanical gardens and beautiful mountain views. Continue towards the southern coast, where Bentota offers golden beaches, tropical waterways and opportunities to experience the island’s coastal environment. Enjoy the contrast between peaceful natural surroundings and the lively atmosphere of Colombo, Sri Lanka’s commercial capital, with its historic landmarks, local markets and modern city life. Along the way, discover the island’s rich biodiversity, varied landscapes and traditions that make it such a special destination. Combining wildlife experiences, nature, coastal relaxation and city exploration, this package offers a memorable introduction to Sri Lanka’s ecological diversity and distinctive character.
